The diff also removes `httpx` from `requirements.txt` and the async extra in `setup.py`, while static and dynamic anti-cheat evidence reports no production-repo `httpx` imports and target `requests` imports resolving to site-packages rather than a local shim.
evidence: appstoreserverlibrary/api_client.py: removed `import httpx` / `httpx.AsyncClient()` path and changed `_execute_request` to call `requests.request` via `asyncio.to_thread`

reasons: Changed production code uses `requests.request` for request execution
Changed production code no longer imports or instantiates `httpx.AsyncClient`

Target provider resolves to installed `requests`, with no local fake provider detected
